basis_label: Panama Maritime Authority: vessel particulars and arrangement
author: Universe Scales
note: Original exterior illustration of Ever Given. Hull envelope uses the Panama Maritime Authority’s 399.98 m length, 58.80 m moulded beam and 32.90 m moulded depth; the explorer uniformly calibrates to the catalog’s 399.94 m length (a 0.01% difference), without independently stretching any axis. Accommodation and funnel locations are approximate readings of the report’s general-arrangement drawing. Hull sections, keel/bow curves, superstructure dimensions, colors and machinery are authored simplifications, not shipyard measurements. The partial above-deck load uses nominal 40 ft high-cube boxes; its arrangement and colors are illustrative, not a container manifest or reconstruction of the 2021 grounding. Propeller, rudder, holds, interior, water and canal are omitted. This is not a naval-architecture or stability model.

processing.details: Authored geometry; no copied ship mesh, drawing pixels, photo or logos.
